name: Account card
purpose: A passive summary card for a single account: the account label (name · masked number), its balance in the display/amount type, and an optional meta row showing account type (Tags atom) and a RAG status (Status-indicator chip). Surfaced as a missing pattern by the payments-journey gap report.

props.name: status
props.$note: Optional RAG status chip in the meta row; meaning carried by the label text, not the dot.
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C12 -- confirm-set. co-mentioned array CONFIRMED as the PROP's (not the component's), Dave's set-confirm sitting. Existing binds array verified to match the ruled proposed_binds exactly. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

variants.name: default
variants.use: Label + balance + meta row (type tag + status chip).

tokens.$balance-type-finding: REVIEW: the balance uses a display/amount type (30px / line-height 1.1 / tabular-nums / -0.01em) with NO dedicated typography token. The gap report flagged 'display/amount type + money-format' as missing — confirm the size/role and add a token, or bind to an existing display type.

commonPatterns: account balance summary on a dashboard
tappable account row that opens account detail (REVIEW: interactive variant?)

behaviour.fallback: identical — the component carries no script

$note.passive: REVIEW: drafted as a passive display card (no states). Decide whether an INTERACTIVE variant is needed (whole card tappable → account detail), which would add hover/pressed/focus like the Cards link variant + a focusable role.

accessibility.role: role="group" with aria-labelledby pointing at the account label, so the card is announced as a single unit.
accessibility.screenReader: REVIEW (inferred): the status dot is decorative (aria-hidden) — meaning is in the chip label text. Confirm the masked number ('···4821') reads acceptably, and whether the balance needs an explicit aria-label (e.g. 'Balance £3,248.55').

antiPatterns: REVIEW (inferred): conveying account status by the dot colour alone — keep the meaning in the label (1.4.1).
REVIEW (inferred): rounding the card corners — cards are square (angular rule; Badge + Avatar are the only round exemptions).
REVIEW (inferred): hard-coding the balance type instead of a display/amount token once one exists.

tokenValidation.against: canon token store (semantic-colour.json); declared values match in light + dark (passes _validate_snippets).
tokenValidation.$note: REVIEW: this is a CANDIDATE from the gap report, not yet reconciled against a Figma component. If HSBC already has an account/balance card, bind to its node + tokens; if net-new, it needs design review + a Figma source.
